people.name: Jake Clifford Ulrich
people.title_or_status: MANAGING PARTNER AND CHIEF COMPLIANCE OFFICER
people.bio_note: Managing Partner and Chief Compliance Officer at Arbor. Studied at Arizona State University, then spent over a decade in banking across multiple sectors, including managing multiple bank branch locations, before co-founding Arbor in 2012. Long-time community volunteer with the Boys and Girls Clubs — involved since 2006, now on the Executive Board of Directors for the Boys and Girls Clubs of Arizona (Phoenix & East Valley).
people.bio_source: arborfirm.com/who-we-are (firm's own website states his Boys and Girls Clubs of Arizona Executive Board of Directors role). Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the previously-cited independent source does not actually contain this detail when checked directly -- corrected to credit the firm's own website, which under current sourcing policy is treated as sufficient on its own. (smartadvisormatch.com/advisor-network/arizona/jake-ulrich-6126128 confirms only his professional history, not this volunteer role.)

people.name: Joseph Christopher Arsenault
people.bio_note: Managing Partner (Co-Founder) at Arbor, a licensed CPA and Personal Financial Specialist (PFS). Graduate of Arizona State University with a background in financial accounting, taxation, and retirement planning. Registered to provide investment advice in Arizona, Texas, and Utah; about 13 years in the industry.
people.bio_source: U.S. News financial advisor profile (money.usnews.com/financial-advisors/advisor/joseph-arsenault-6126101), corroborating arborfirm.com/who-we-are/
